جَنَابَةٌ : see جَنْبٌ, in four places: and see جَانِبٌ. ＝
-A2- See also جَنْبَةٌ. ―
-b2- Accord. to IAth, its primary signification is Distance: and hence it signifies The state of him who is under the obligation of performing a total ablution, by reason of sexual intercourse and discharge of the semen. (TA.) ―
-b3- The sperma genitalis [itself]. (K. [But in a marginal note in my copy of that work I find this last signification rejected as erroneous.]) ＝
-A3- See also the next paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
